messages:
sarah-ops: Hey team — auditor just asked for an "inventory" of artifacts that tie recent RBAC changes (April rollout) to audit logs, KMS key rotation events, and any incident tickets. They want pointers or exported snapshots by EOD.

omar-sec: Can we produce a package that maps: change PR -> iam change event -> API calls affected -> any related incidents? auditor wants evidence that change approvals happened + post-change monitoring. :thinking_face:

jess-eng: Yep. We have the PRs in github:org/redwood/infra (recently labelled rbac-change). I can run evidence-collector to pull CloudTrail entries and the Kubernetes audit logs. Example query I plan to run: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=iam::role/redwood-service```

michael-sre: Also include the k8s audit policy slice for the namespace. We rotate the KMS key for secrets-store on 2024-04-12 — include the KMS rotation entry: ```kms:ScheduleKeyRotation -> arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01``` and the associated CloudTrail event ids.

omar-sec: Important: show the RBAC change PR had required approvers and the approval audit (github org audit logs + internal approval workflow). If approvals were via Slack, include the message permalink. If not, include the CODEOWNERS entry and the merge check status.

lucy-legal: Auditor will need control mapping: map artifacts to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2.1 (access provisioning). Please attach a one-paragraph explanation for each artifact describing how it satisfies the control. Keep it high level.

jess-eng: I'll produce a spreadsheet mapping artifacts -> evidence type -> link (S3 presigned / GDrive) -> control mapping. Plan: 1) export CloudTrail slices (time-range +-24h of merge), 2) export k8s audit snippet, 3) export KMS rotation log and key metadata, 4) attach PR and approval history, 5) list any incident tickets and post-change monitoring alerts.

audit_bot: export_job_8367: snapshot created at s3://redwood-compliance/audit-snapshots/1967654321-2024-04-13.tar.gz (expires in 7d). Artifacts: cloudtrail_slice.json, k8s_audit.json, github_prs.csv, kms_rotation_events.json, incidents_list.csv.

sarah-ops: Nice. Two quick Qs: 1) Do we have deterministic mapping between GitHub PR IDs and CloudTrail event IDs? 2) Any potential gaps if the change touched IAM via Terraform automation rather than manual console edits?

omar-sec: 1) We can usually match by timestamp + actor (github actions user / committer). If terraform applied through CI, the CloudTrail actor is the CI role — include the run id and workflow run URL. 2) Gaps: console UI changes have different event names (ConsoleLogin + UpdateRole) vs assume-role calls from CI. We'll document matching heuristics in the spreadsheet.

michael-sre: For incidents, include links to PagerDuty incidents and the postmortem if any alert fired. If there were alerts but no incidents, add the alert rule snapshots from Grafana (panel export).

jess-eng: I'm going to start the collector job now. Will upload the spreadsheet to the snapshot and ping here with links. ETA ~3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lucy-legal: For the one-paragraph control mapping, use phrasing: "Artifact X demonstrates [control objective], the evidence file is [link], retention period [policy], responsible owner [team/person]." Keeps auditor happy.

omar-sec: Tagging recommended owners: @jess-eng (evidence), @michael-sre (monitoring), @sarah-ops (prod access review). Also flag any P0 gaps.

jess-eng: Update: collector finished. Uploaded artifacts to s3 link (presigned): https://s3-presigned.example/redwood-compliance/1967654321-2024-04-13.tar.gz :thumbsup: Spreadsheet at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example (read-only).

sarah-ops: Got it. I'll draft the one-paragraph control mappings and attach to the shared folder. Who wants to do a quick cross-check before we hand to auditor? :eyes:

omar-sec: I'll spot-check IAM mapping and KMS rotation entries in ~30m.

michael-sre: I'll verify the Grafana alert snapshots and incident links.

lucy-legal: I'll review the control mapping language and confirm it maps to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2 requirements.

jess-eng: All set — marked the spreadsheet rows with owners and status. If auditor asks for raw CloudTrail event IDs, we included them in cloudtrail_slice.json (field eventId).

sarah-ops: Perfect. If anyone finds any missing link or a gap, respond in this thread and we'll escalate via runbook. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
